title: Rectified dg model comparison for enriched internal Hom
statement:
Use the universes and dg-category localization $\mathsf{Hqe}$ of [lem-coef-dgcat-model-structure], the derived enrichment in the enhanced derived category $\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)$ of [lem-coef-dg-enrichment-rectification], and the coherent tensor and internal Hom of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus]. Let $\mathcal J,\mathcal B,\mathcal R_0$ be small dg categories over $\mathbf Z$. Write $\mathcal A\otimes^L\mathcal J=Q\mathcal A\otimes Q\mathcal J$ for the derived tensor, and assume its derived enrichment agrees with the enriched tensor. Suppose given bijections, natural in every small dg category $\mathcal A$,
$$\alpha_{\mathcal A}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathsf{Hqe}}(\mathcal A,\mathcal R_0)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathsf{Hqe}}(\mathcal A\otimes^L\mathcal J,\mathcal B).$$
Let $\mathcal F=\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)}(\mathcal J,\mathcal B)$, where the inputs denote derived enrichments. There is a small dg rectification $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{dg}}$ of $\mathcal F$ and an equivalence $e:\mathcal R_0\simeq\mathcal F_{\mathrm{dg}}$ in the enhanced localization, identifying the derived mapping objects. Its homotopy class realizes the given representing bijections. In particular the evaluation map obtained from $\alpha_{\mathcal R_0}(1)$ agrees, under $e$, with coherent enriched evaluation up to a homotopy in the enhanced localization.

source.place: Haugseng, Rectification of enriched infinity-categories, Theorem 5.8 and Example 5.11; representing-object comparison combined with the closed tensor in On the tensor product of enriched infinity-categories, Remark 9.5 (https://arxiv.org/html/2311.13362v1). Agent specialization; read online, not archived. No Stacks tag supplies this dg-enriched comparison.
